pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

7. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

10. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. C — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain symbols used on a map

6. B — Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. A — Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Plan income and spending wisely

12. D — Nairobi

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Agriculture; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
